adoption.notes: Implements the core only through sensor-configuration/v1, which adopts it; nothing cites this contract directly. From 54f181ab it refuses, in ori/hal/config_schema.py, at document validation and, for an `enum` member or a `default`, at schema load, a `number` value that is not finite (NaN or infinity, which YAML can write as .nan and .inf) or that has no finite double value, such as an integer too large for one. This version refuses a non-finite bound but says nothing about a non-finite value, so no rule here addresses the refusal; a document carrying such a value is not portable between consumers until a successor version states the rule.
